clue.text: Indisciplined pair sacked, soldiers lined up for the treatment?

definitions.text: soldiers lined up for the treatment?

indicators.note: troops without discipline fall out of line, so these letters break ranks and re-form

explanation.surface: An unruly couple are dismissed while the troops queue up for their punishment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Indisciplined' rearranges PAIR SACKED. A sick parade is the military morning muster of soldiers reporting ill to see the medical officer.
explanation.definitionFit: Military term: the line-up of soldiers reporting to the medic for medical attention each morning.

clue.text: Old runner on the track struggling for breath, close to admitting suffering

explanation.definitionFit: The name of one of the first steam railway engines, an old machine that ran on rails.
